resolution.title: Add test cases to verify hashing for IPinIP packet
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes #7569
This PR is to add a test case to verity the hashing for IPinIP packet.
It's expected that the `src_ip`, `dst_ip`, `src_port` and `dst_port` of inner packet are used as hash key.
This PR also adds a negative test case to verify the length of inner_frame is not used as hash key.
### Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [x] Test case(new/improvement)

### Back port request
- [ ] 201911
- [x] 202012
- [x] 202205

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
This PR is to add test cases to verify hashing for IPinIP packet.

#### How did you do it?
Added two test cases
1. test_ipinip_hash to verify the `src_ip`, `dst_ip`, `src_port` and `dst_port` of inner packet are used as hashing key.
2. test_ipinip_hash_negative to verify inner_frame length is not used as hashing key.

#### How did you verify/test it?
The change is verified on a Cisco T1 testbed and Arista T1 testbed.

#### Any platform specific information?
Test case `test_ipinip_hash` is running only on Cisco platform at this moment.
The negative test case `test_ipinip_hash_negative` should run on all platforms.

#### Supported testbed topology if it's a new test case?
Test case `test_ipinip_hash` runs only on T1 topology.
Test case `test_ipinip_hash_negative` should run on all topologies.
